name: member-list
title: Member List
description: The people in a team, a space or a share list — an add row (picker · optional role · Add) and 36px rows (avatar · name over a muted sub line · role chip menu or text · ⋯ with Remove) that scroll after eight.

meta.whenToUse: Who is in a team or space, who an item is shared with, an invite list — add, change role, remove.
meta.whenNotToUse: A directory of many people with columns, search and filters (DataList), or one person's chip (RecordChip).
